I have now looked at the test input gridlines and I am confirming this trend.

I'm now focused on the relationship between grid lines and the final output.  I've realized the grid lines partition the input into cells, but I'm still puzzled why certain training examples produce a 3x3 output, even with more gridlines. I'm investigating how the bounding box and the output are related. I'm taking a closer look at the test input and its intersection values, trying to establish a definitive rule!

I'm now analyzing the pattern within the formed cells, specifically focusing on how the corner values determine cell characteristics. I've examined 5x5 cells formed by the grid lines at 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, and 23. This is based on the provided sample, where I've identified cells with all corners matching.
